tiles.completed: Each tiles.*: a stat tile's label on the Value page. A session is a stretch of one chat; completed, answered and abandoned are how it ended (see outcomes.description).
tiles.completedShare: The share of sessions that were completed, as a percentage.
tiles.resumption: The share of chats people came back to after a break.
outcomes.title: Heading of the card about how sessions ended.
outcomes.description: Defines the three outcomes (operations:outcomes.*). "Turn": one answer from a socio (an AI agent; product noun). "Approval": a person allowing a socio's action.
outcomes.legend: A legend item under the outcome bar. {{outcome}} is one of the outcomes (Completed…), {{n}} its sessions, {{share}} a percentage.
chart.title: Heading over the chart of one outcome's sessions; one form per outcome.
chart.series: The chart's name, for screen readers; one form per outcome.
chart.axis: The chart's value in its accessible description ("Bar chart of sessions by day…"); lowercase.
chart.label: Accessible name of the menu that picks which outcome the chart shows.
chart.empty: In place of the chart when the range has no data.
intents.title: Heading of the table of how sessions ended by intent (what people wanted: asking, writing…).
intents.description: <link> wraps the name of the Themes page (operations:sections.themes.label) and links to it. "Operations → Settings" names a page of this dashboard.
approvals.title: Heading of the card of approvals: actions socios (AI agents) asked people to allow.
approvals.row: A capability's funnel: how many actions socios asked for, people allowed, denied, let expire, and were carried out (done). The _failed form adds those that failed.
reactions.title: Heading of the card of people's reactions to socios' answers.
reactions.reacted: Label of a figure: socio answers that got any reaction.
reactions.reacted-value: That figure: {{reacted}} of {{total}} answers, {{share}} as a percentage.
reactions.up: Each of up, down, retry and needs-work: a reaction people can give an answer, as the chat's reaction buttons name them.
lists.title: Heading of the card with tabs of socios' usefulness and people's sessions.
lists.socios: Tab, and its list's accessible name. "Socios" are AI agents (product noun).
lists.sessions: Tab, and its list's accessible name.
usefulness.completed: In a socio's row: {{share}} is the share of its sessions completed (a percentage), of {{count}} sessions. Joined with " · " to usefulness.back and .repeat.
usefulness.back: {{share}}: the share of its people who came back within 7 days.
usefulness.repeat: {{share}}: the share of its people who used it on 2 or more of the last 28 days.
sessions.outcome: Accessible name of the menu that narrows the sessions to one outcome.
sessions.every-outcome: The menu's choice that shows sessions of every outcome.
sessions.a-chat: In place of a session's socio name when it has none.
